Title: Arc Insights PBI Dashboards Powered by Jumpstart
Summary: Arc SQL estate strategy v3.5.1 Power BI template for Azure and Arc inventory, extension coverage, ESU forecasting, patch/CVE insights and SQL best-practice findings.
Description: This Power BI template connects to Azure Resource Graph to visualise Azure virtual machines and Arc-enabled servers, SQL Server instances, databases, extensions and resource tags. Version 3.5.1 retains inventory and Extended Security Update (ESU) forecasting pages and adds Security Patching CVE Audit and Best Practices pages. Patch assessments are enriched with public vendor advisories; SQL configuration findings use Arc inventory and identify deeper assessment coverage gaps. ESU and migration/licensing outputs are scenario estimates, not official quotes. Import the template in Power BI Desktop and authenticate with your own account. The existing template filename and download link are preserved.
